name: atlias-efficiency
description: Optional cuts to what Claude Code sends on every call, each its own switch, all off by default.

enabled.title: Atlias efficiency
enabled.description: Defer supported built-in tools behind native ToolSearch. Requires a compatible endpoint.

skillListing.title: Brief skill listing
skillListing.description: Cut each skill's description in the listing to one line. Skill names and a skill's own instructions are never changed. Needs Atlias efficiency on.

hotGlob.title: Keep Glob visible
hotGlob.description: Leave Glob natively visible instead of deferring it, and do not name it as deferred. Set the transaction mod's hotGlob too when both mods are loaded. Needs Atlias efficiency on.

skillNamesOnly.title: Skill names only
skillNamesOnly.description: List skills by name only, with no description. Every skill stays available and its own instructions are never changed. Overrides Brief skill listing. Needs Atlias efficiency on.

omitMemorySection.title: Leave out Claude Code's memory instructions
omitMemorySection.description: Omit the system prompt's own memory section; Atlias's memory tools take its place. Every other section is untouched. Needs Atlias efficiency on.

compactToolText.title: Compact tool text
compactToolText.description: Replace the long usage notes of Bash, Read and ToolSearch with short ones. The opening of each description and every schema stay as they are. Needs Atlias efficiency on.
